property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID (Optional)
property.description: Record ID to link the file to. Leave empty to only return ContentDocumentId.

property.name: label
property.label: Label
property.description: Label for the file upload field

property.name: buttonLabel
property.label: Button Label
property.description: Label for the file selection button

property.name: acceptedFormats
property.label: Accepted Formats
property.description: Comma-separated file extensions (e.g., .pdf,.jpg,.png). Leave empty for all formats.

property.name: maxFileSize
property.label: Max File Size (bytes)
property.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Default: 4.5MB

property.name: required
property.label: Required
property.description: Whether the file upload is required
